name: @mesh/hyprland-keybinds
description: Hyprland keybinds read from the Lua config: every hl.bind with a description, grouped by its --##! section comments.

capabilities: exec.argv:sh:["-c","for f in \"$HOME/.config/hypr/hyprland/keybinds.lua\" \"$HOME/.config/hypr/custom/keybinds.lua\"; do [ -f \"$f\" ] && { cat \"$f\"; echo; }; done; true"]
